faq.label: FAQ
faq.heading: Pricing Questions
faq.a1: No. Quotes from our sales team exclude VAT as required by local regulation, and you get the full breakdown before you subscribe.
faq.q2: What counts as an MAU (Monthly Active User)?
faq.a2: An MAU is a unique customer who interacts with your business in a given month. One customer counts once, no matter how many messages they send that month.
faq.q3: What is the difference between AI Simple and AI Full?
faq.a3: AI Simple answers questions from the knowledge base you provide. AI Full adds the ability to run more complex flows such as lead qualification, follow-ups, and taking action inside the chat.
faq.q4: Can I start with just one plan?
faq.a4: Yes. Many businesses start with Chat and add CRM or Marketing once the team settles in. Everything runs on the same platform, so your data connects the moment you add a product.
faq.q5: What if I need more than the largest plan?
faq.a5: Take the Custom plan. We size the capacity, seats, and integrations around your requirements, and confirm the commercial terms with you first.
faq.q6: Are there setup fees or minimum contracts?
faq.a6: Regular plans carry no separate setup fee and no minimum contract. For Custom, the commercial terms are agreed with our sales team before you begin.

faq.a3: Cekat.AI sets up in under a week on a 3-month minimum contract. For comparison, Mekari Qontak is around 3 weeks, Halo AI around 2 months and Sierra up to 6 months, on minimum terms of 6 months to a year.
faq.q4: Do I need a separate subscription for CRM and marketing?
faq.a4: No. Chat, CRM, marketing and order automation are all included in one Cekat.AI subscription. On some other platforms, CRM is only available on Pro or Enterprise tiers, or billed separately per agent.
faq.a5: Not yet. Cekat.AI supports TikTok Ads, Meta Ads, WhatsApp Broadcast, ROAS analytics and customer segmentation, but is not connected to Google Ads.
faq.q6: Where does this comparison data come from?
faq.a6: From publicly available information on each vendor's own site, compiled as of August 2026. Platform capabilities change over time, so confirm directly with the vendor before deciding.
